standards.name: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Framework
standards.reviewedBehavior: client-credentials grant and token endpoint client authentication

standards.name: OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange
standards.reviewedBehavior: subject and actor token distinction, requested and issued token types, resource, audience and scope

boundaries.clientAuthentication: classified secret reference or assertion-service reference; values resolve only at runtime
boundaries.subjectAndActor: explicit non-ambient sources with distinct provenance and token types
boundaries.cache: bounded in-memory storage keyed by every security-relevant profile, subject, actor, resource, audience, scope and token-type dimension
boundaries.diagnostics: client identity, grant kind and outcome only; no token, assertion, secret or response body
boundaries.authority: transport token only; no permission, downscope, on-behalf-of, delegation or impersonation conclusion
boundaries.failure: cancellation and outage fail closed; no automatic retry
